newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAILAND CONFIRMS ACCPETANCE OF IMF LOAN PACKAGE.
newsitem.headline: THAILAND CONFIRMS ACCPETANCE OF IMF LOAN PACKAGE.

text.p: Thailand will send a letter of intent to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) on Wednesday confirming its decision to accept a $16 billion international loan package for the country, a finance ministerial source said.
The official said the letter would repeat Thailand's decision to enter an austerity programme to meet IMF demands. The loan package includes a $4 billion stand-by credit from the IMF.
He said the Thai confirmation would reiterate a government plan to cut its 1997/1998 (October-September) fiscal budget by 50-75 billion baht ($1.6-2.4 billion). He did not elaborate.
